decision: stzlib's three findings on haro.exe, fixed in Haro; Ring 1.27 the specification of a .ring file
class: run: exact stdout and exit code on haro and its checked build, the same bytes; check: the report holds (has) or lacks (not) a rule name

lines.K1: a keyed read is never an uncounted integer
lines.K2: a call on a receiver is no unqualified call

cases.why: a keyed read of missing keys in a loop answers as Ring, never freeing the empty text
a missing key's answer is the empty text, and the name holding it is a text until it is set again
a method called on a receiver is not the class's own: no arity error
an unqualified call of the class's own method with the wrong arity is still reported (must not move)
object2pointer and pointer2object as Ring's: one object, shared, pointers equal
object2pointer of no object is Bad parameter type, in its name
